title: CrmCreateDealInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win) — chain-authored config and DAG-forwarded inputs are both legal sources, so nothing is `required` here; the SURFACE refuses a missing key with a typed `validation_error` (a node failure, never success-with-empty).

dealId.description: Explicit `deal:`-prefixed id (ADR 0162). Omitted, the node derives `deal:${runId}:${nodeId}` — a PER-RUN dedupe key (a retried node converges), not a cross-run fork guard; the `side-effect` classification is the guard.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline; defaults to the org's default.

stageId.description: Stage; defaults to the pipeline's first stage.
